name: jswork
description: An extensible AX framework for team-oriented AI-assisted engineering.

interface.shortDescription: Build AX workflows with composable Codex capabilities.
interface.longDescription: JSWORK is an extensible AX framework for Codex. It combines approval-aware project initialization, a reusable large-scope exploration agent, and a five-role implementation team with role-specific project agents.
capabilities: Approval-aware project Codex and custom-agent initialization
defaultPrompt: Use the explore project agent to inspect this large file set and return a summary.
Coordinate this change as a JSFWORK team workflow.
Use $jswork:setup to configure and verify JSWORK for this repository.
